entries.title: Noble Fates
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC Steam Early Access build

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC Early Access presentation.

primary.why: Noble Fates is documented on Steam as a Windows Early Access 3D fantasy kingdom-management sim with colony sim, city-builder, survival, and Steam Workshop support. No sourced console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass. The Windows PC Steam build is the only sourced route, but the archive recommendation is provisional while the game remains Early Access.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam Early Access build only if an in-development archive run is acceptable; otherwise wait for 1.0 and revalidate.

entries.remaster_caveats: Early Access game: revalidate at 1.0 before treating this as a final definitive archive route.
